node.title: Re: Where did all the time go?
node.author: Fletch
node.doctext:
Tangential, but you might look at [mod://POSIX] and strftime or something like [mod://DateTime::Format] rather than monkeying with reimplementing wheels.

As to your question you can see how the precedence changes omitting the parens plays out if you stick -MO=Deparse,-p before the -e.
